outcome: Mode of birth (including Caesarean section and emergency Caesarean deliveries)
cohort: All women booked for antenatal care at Guys and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust in inner city London, specifically those residing in four deprived council wards, between July 2018 and June 2020.
finding: Caseload midwifery care significantly reduced preterm birth rate and caesarean section births compared to traditional midwifery care in a deprived inner-city population.
mod_finding: Caseload midwifery care significantly reduced both overall caesarean section births and emergency caesarean deliveries when compared with traditional midwifery care.
